pairs.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, 4-bit · one R9700 · writing
pairs.condition: Strata's author, one Radeon AI PRO R9700 capped at 225 W, EPYC 7452 with 8 channels of DDR4-2400, the same UD-Q4_K_XL file. Strata 63-64 tok/s on a short story, 85-88 on code, with its default MTP drafting; llama.cpp 8bb3cf0d2 with --n-cpu-moe 38-48, no drafting.

pairs.title: The same computer · reading
pairs.condition: Strata read a 32K-token prompt at 1,110-1,320 tok/s; llama.cpp read a 4K prompt at 198-257 tok/s. The shorter prompt favours llama.cpp.

pairs.title: GLM-5.3-Flash · R9700 cards · writing
